answer: Because the timing is recorded against the nadir challenge, the garden audit can replay the hollow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 126 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 3 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
